 Dejounte Murray scores 23 points Wednesday 
 by Ari Koslow | Pelicans Correspondent | Thu, Oct 22nd 2026, 2:46am EDT 
 Dejounte Murray scored 23 points (9-18 FG, 2-5 3PT, 3-3 FT) to go along with three rebounds, seven assists, two steals and three blocks in the Pelicans 123-120 loss against the Pacers. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Murray scored a team-high 23 points with a full stat line. He'll look to bounce back this season if he can stay healthy.
